captions.detailed: An ultra-wide rectilinear prime lens with a matte black finish. It features a wide, bulging front element housing that transitions into a narrower rear barrel. The lens has two rotating rings: a wide focus ring located near the front, and a narrower aperture ring located near the rear, both decorated with small white indicator markings. These rings rotate independently on separate revolute joints around the central optical axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an ultra-wide rectilinear prime lens with a matte black finish. The lens must feature a wide front housing, a narrower rear barrel, a rotating focus ring near the front, and a rotating aperture ring near the rear, both modeled with revolute joints and decorated with white indicator markings.
captions.factory: Construct the main lens body using concentric cylinders of varying diameters and heights, combined with a tapered cone section for the transition. Model the front lens element using a dark blue/grey reflective glass material. Create the focus ring and aperture ring as separate cylindrical shells, adding a small white rectangular indicator box on the outer face of each. Establish two revolute joints along the central Z-axis to allow independent rotation of the focus and aperture rings relative to the main barrel.
